messages:
Maya K: Nightly RAG evals show top-k recall down ~6% on cohort 'kb-short' after last reranker rollout. Shared the nightly digest below. Anyone else seeing this?

Aj Patel: Looking now. Which rollout are you referring to? The reranker v2.3 PR went live at 02:15 UTC.

Sasha R: yea merged PR #4728 (score-normalization) — I added a small per-document rescale to reduce long-doc bias.

Ben L: pulled nightly artifacts: evals-bot summary https://redwood-evals/internal/2001234567

evals-bot: nightly-rag: cohort=kb-short topk=5 recall@5=0.842 -> 0.782 (delta -0.06) ndcg down 0.04. failing prompts: 13/500.

Maya K: hmm looks correlated by doc length. The failing examples prefer long answers.

Sasha R: that's consistent with the rescale — it reduces long-doc scores slightly. I thought it improved precision.

Aj Patel: can we repro locally? Maya, can you paste one failing query + golden passages?

Maya K: sure
Maya K: Query: "How does multi-level caching affect latency under burst?"
Maya K: Golden top doc id: doc-8347 (long, 4k tokens)

Ben L: ran local rerank with pre-rollout weights vs post-rollout: topk contains doc-8347 in pre but not post. Scores:
Ben L: ```
pre: doc-8347 score=3.27
post: doc-8347 score=2.11
``` 

Sasha R: ok that delta is big. My change multiplies scores by 1/(1+log(len_tokens)). For 4k tokens that's ~0.7 factor.

Aj Patel: can we test removing rescale only for docs > 2k in rerank config? quick canary.

Maya K: also curious if embedding refresh could interact — were embeddings updated around same time?

evals-bot: embedding-index-updates: last_update=2001231200 (03:00 UTC), reranker-deploy=2001232500 (03:15 UTC)

Maya K: order suggests embed refresh before reranker -> unlikely to change score distribution that much.

Ben L: I can run a small A/B locally: dataset of 2k queries, compare recall@5 with rescale on/off and with quantized weights (we rolled quant model to saved variant).

Sasha R: note: we also shipped a quantized-reranker artifact for smaller GPU at the same time. Could quantization shift logits?

Aj Patel: good catch. quantization can shift calibration. Ben, include quantized vs float in A/B.

Ben L: running now. ETA ~30m.

infra-bot: deploys: rolled back candidate tag reranker:v2.3-canary to reranker:v2.2 at 2001233600 (03:40 UTC) per request by maya-k

Maya K: thanks infra. Ben please share numbers.

(30m later)

Ben L: results: baseline (v2.2 float) recall@5=0.842, v2.3 float (rescale) recall@5=0.784, v2.3 float (rescale disabled) recall@5=0.839, v2.3 quant recall@5=0.776

Sasha R: summary: main culprit is rescale; quantization worsens it slightly.

Aj Patel: action: revert rescale from mainline, add unit test for long-doc score stability, and move quantized artifact to canary only until we have calibration step. Assigning Sasha for revert + test, Ben to run calibration sweep on quant.

Sasha R: on it. I'll open PR to revert and add test. ETA 2h.

Ben L: I'll start quant calibration job and run evals; will post results.

Maya K: thanks team. Follow-up: add a regression check to nightly to detect >3% drop in recall for long-doc cohorts.

Aj Patel: good idea. I'll add monitor rule in alerts.

Maya K: closing loop once we see green on next nightly.
